$statusLegend.ported: byte-equivalent to upstream (CI fails on drift)
$statusLegend.adapted: TypeScript port and/or namespace swap; logically equivalent
$statusLegend.extended: fork adds behavior on top of upstream
$statusLegend.added: file unique to the fork (no upstream)

files.notes: name, ancestor and textdomain swapped to the artisanpack namespace; adds prefix / singular / plural / suffix attributes, an enum on displayType, the artisanpack/queryPreview context, and the position + animation supports the query family carries. style handle dropped.

Upstream previews a hard-coded '12 results found' / 'Displaying 1 – 10 of 12'. The fork previews the surrounding query's resolved count from artisanpack/queryPreview (sample 25 results, 9 per page, before it settles) and adds text controls for the prefix, nouns and suffix.
Dynamic block — `save` returns null; markup produced server-side from the `_resolvedTotal` page snapshot stamped by QueryInliner.
Bidirectional core/query-total ↔ artisanpack/query-total transforms, matching the rest of the query family.
Single inline SVG instead of upstream's per-display-type icon set.
Adapted to the visual-editor auto-discovery contract.

knownDivergences: Output wraps the number(s) in and reads '{prefix}25 results{suffix}' / '{prefix}1–9 of 25 results{suffix}' instead of upstream's fixed '25 results found' / 'Displaying 1 – 9 of 25', so themes can emphasise and relabel the count.
The count comes from QueryInliner's paginator snapshot rather than a second WP_Query; inherit loops use whatever paginator the host resolver returns.
